# Generated by My LVGL Studio: builds LVGL and the designed screens for the desktop.
#   cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DLVGL_DIR=<folder of the LVGL sources>
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(lvgl_app C)

set(LVGL_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lvgl" CACHE PATH "Folder of the LVGL sources")
if(NOT EXISTS "${LVGL_DIR}/lvgl.h")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "LVGL was not found in ${LVGL_DIR}; pass -DLVGL_DIR=<folder of the LVGL sources>")
endif()

file(GLOB_RECURSE LVGL_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${LVGL_DIR}/src/*.c")
add_library(lvgl STATIC ${LVGL_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(lvgl PUBLIC "${LVGL_DIR}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/config")
target_compile_definitions(lvgl PUBLIC LV_CONF_INCLUDE_SIMPLE)
target_compile_options(lvgl PRIVATE -O2 -w)

# The application's own code: every C and C++ file in src/app, however many there are.
file(GLOB APP_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/app/*.c")
file(GLOB APP_CXX_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/app/*.cpp")
if(APP_CXX_SOURCES)
  enable_language(CXX)
endif()

add_executable(app
  src/main.c
  lib/mvvm/mvvm.c
  lib/mvvm/mvvm_lvgl.c
  src/glue/glue.c
  src/ui/screens/ui_Panel.c
  src/ui/ui.c
  src/ui/ui_events.c
  ${APP_SOURCES}
  ${APP_CXX_SOURCES}
)
target_include_directories(app PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/ui" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/glue" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/app" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/mvvm")
target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE lvgl)
target_compile_definitions(app PRIVATE UI_FONT_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/fonts")
if(ML_HEADLESS)
  target_compile_definitions(app PRIVATE ML_HEADLESS)
else()
  find_package(SDL2 REQUIRED CONFIG)
  target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE SDL2::SDL2)
endif()
if(NOT WIN32)
  target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE m)
endif()
